goal: Use the existing component Inventory UI to mutate canonical Item Graph equipment state through CH9.1 and drive the accepted CH8 character presenter from CH9.0 snapshots.
graphical_acceptance: inventory opens with a visible five-slot equipment panel
helmet backpack upper lower and feet items are visible in the normal backpack
dragging a wearable into its equipment slot removes it from backpack and shows it on the character
dragging it back removes the character visual and returns the same item to backpack
dropping a second compatible wearable onto an occupied slot performs one-for-one replacement
Tab closes inventory and character can walk run turn jump and crouch with equipment intact
body-visible inflated garments do not expose the previous leg truncation artifact
no laboratory U L K H B mutation is required

windows_attempt_1.runner_reason: ERROR markers despite script exit code 0
windows_attempt_1.engine_error: Parameter body->get_space() is null in GodotPhysicsServer3D::body_test_motion
windows_attempt_1.diagnosis: Inventory open intentionally disables the CharacterBody3D process mode; the inherited parent lab continued to call move_and_slide on the body after CollisionObject3D left PhysicsServer space.

fix1.behavior: QuaterniusItemGraphEquipmentLab overrides _physics_process and skips inherited movement while canonical inventory state is open; closing inventory restores PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT and the inherited movement loop.
fix1.regression_gate: composition test holds inventory open across physics frames, then closes it and crosses another physics frame; runner rejects any ERROR marker

windows_attempt_2.graphical_launcher_error: ParserError TerminatorExpectedAtEndOfString at PLAY_CH9_2_INVENTORY_CHARACTER_LAB.ps1 line 77 near the -- argument

fix2.scope: PowerShell graphical launcher only plus runner validation

fix2.reason: Avoid Windows PowerShell encoding/parser ambiguity and ensure graphical launcher syntax is part of the automated acceptance surface.
